title: Negatives and Questions Quiz 2
description: Form negatives and questions with did, was, were and had, and keep the verb in the right form.
topic: Past simple, past continuous and past perfect
instructions: Negatives and Questions: Past simple, past continuous and past perfect.
Read each question carefully, then check your answer.
Every question has a trap. Read every word.

questions.question: Which question is correct?
questions.explanation: Did takes the past form, so the main verb is the base form: see. Watch out: Did you saw is wrong because the past tense is marked twice.

questions.question: Make the negative: 'We went to the cinema.'
options: We didn't go to the cinema.
We didn't went to the cinema.
We don't go to the cinema.
We not went to the cinema.
questions.explanation: Past simple negative: did not + base verb. Watch out: went returns to go after didn't.

questions.question: {{1}} it {{2}} (rain) when you left?
questions.explanation: When you left gives a moment in the past, so the question is past continuous: Was it raining? Watch out: was is already the helper, so did is not added.

questions.question: They {{1}} (not / arrive) before the film started.
questions.explanation: The earlier past action takes the past perfect negative: had not + past participle. Watch out: not didn't arrive, which would not show which action came first.

questions.question: 'Did she was late?' is correct.
questions.explanation: The question is Was she late? Watch out: was and were are helpers themselves, so did is never added.

questions.question: Which question is correct?
options: Did they had left before you arrived?
Have they left before you arrived?
Were they left before you arrived?
Had they left before you arrived?
questions.explanation: The past perfect question is Had + subject + past participle. Watch out: did never combines with had + participle.

questions.question: Choose the correct negative helper.
questions.explanation: Each sentence has a clue: yesterday for the past simple, at ten for the past continuous, before we arrived for the past perfect, last night for was. Watch out: was not is used with I, he, she and it.

questions.question: Match each sentence with its question.
questions.explanation: Move the first helper in front of the subject. Watch out: They visited Rome has no helper, so did is added and visited becomes visit.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order to make a question.
questions.explanation: Had goes first, then the subject, then the adverb and the participle. Watch out: the participle left stays after already.

questions.question: Which sentences are correct?
options: Did he call you last night?
Had you eaten before the show?
questions.explanation: Only the sentences with the right helper and verb form are correct. Watch out: didn't saw and was they break the rules for did and plural subjects.

questions.question: Which sentence has a mistake?
questions.explanation: Did you had breakfast? is wrong, and the correct question is Did you have breakfast? Watch out: negative questions such as Didn't he phone you? are correct.

questions.question: Correct the mistake: He didn't came to the party.
accepted: He didn't come to the party.
He didn't come to the party
He didn’t come to the party.
He didn’t come to the party
He did not come to the party.
He did not come to the party
questions.explanation: After didn't the verb is in the base form: He didn't come. Watch out: the past is already marked in didn't.
